meta.title: Lowgear Cycle Works | Bike repairs in Hackney
meta.description: Bike servicing, puncture and brake fixes while you wait, wheel building and steel frame restoration in a railway arch off Mare Street, Hackney.

rationale: A Swiss poster fits a workshop that is all function: a white page, one red signal colour and a heavy grotesque, with prices and steps set like a timetable. The big index, the single huge price and the drawing of the arch with a steel bike in it make the page look like a printed workshop sheet, not a template.

props.title: What we do and roughly what it costs

items.name: Servicing
items.description: We go through the whole bike, adjust what needs adjusting and tell you what is wearing out before it lets you down.

items.name: Punctures and brakes
items.description: Fixed while you wait. Couriers and commuters, this one is for you.

items.name: Wheel building
items.description: Rim, hub and spokes chosen with you, then laced and trued by hand in the arch.

items.name: Steel frame restoration
items.description: Old steel frames looked over, brought back and built up again. Dami's favourite job, so bring the one from the shed.

steps.name: Turn up or book
steps.detail: Walk in off Mare Street, or book a slot if you want to be sure we have a stand free.

steps.name: We look at it with you
steps.detail: Dami or Rosa checks the bike and tells you what it needs and what it costs before any work starts.

steps.name: We fix it
steps.detail: Punctures and brakes while you wait. Bigger jobs are done the same day where we can.

steps.name: Ride away
steps.detail: Pay, collect the bike and go.

props.title: Two people in a railway arch
paragraphs: Lowgear Cycle Works is Dami and Rosa, working out of a railway arch just off Mare Street in Hackney.
Most of the people who come in are couriers and commuters. They ride every day and cannot be without the bike, so we work to get it back to them the same day.
Then there are the old steel frames. Dami loves restoring them and will happily talk about yours.
props.pullQuote: Old steel frames are the bit I love. Dami
